description: MECHANICAL post-production on an EXISTING video (URL): ordered primitives run by ffmpeg, ~2 credits flat, NO AI model, as a NEW video. Ops: a branded end card, trim, speed (0.5-2x), mute (whole or a window), audio_gain (-20..+6 dB), fade_out, music (a bed under the clip, ducked: omit track = a free library track picked by mood, no attribution; or track = an audio link: an upload_file URL, a find_sound or generate_sfx link, a video post's sound; track 'generate' composes it, paid, ONLY when the user asks; start/end, db, replace), voiceover (text spoken OVER it, its sound ducked; ~2.5 words/s; voice female|male; +~1 credit), watermark (brand logo), grain (anti-AI), text (timed words in a native look: style 'tiktok-classic' default / 'clean-minimal' / 'note-style' or a textStyle; start/end, or at:{word} and until:{word} to time them to a spoken phrase), join (this video FOLLOWED BY clips[]: Library URLs, direct files or public post links, as one 1080x1920 video), layout (ONLY when asked: split screen, cut-out or green-screen presenter, letterbox, fisheye; whole video or a start/end window). Presets are shortcuts: x/y, grain amount, join transition and bridge sound are free parameters. 'A viral hook, then our clip' = videoUrl: the hook's post link + [{op:'join', clips:[{url: ours}], bridge}], and it ALWAYS gets a bridge unless the user asks for a bare cut: {kind:'impact'} cuts the hook just before its payoff (cutAt overrides) and lands our clip on a punch-in and flash, with the payoff sound FROM THE HOOK ITSELF: its own audio carries across the cut, else one generated from its frames (up to 8 credits), else a neutral impact. {kind:'text', text, then?} only when the user asks for words over the cut. ANY OTHER EDIT, op or bridge (whip, zoom, freeze, wipe, split screen, generated shot) is edit_timeline: free keyframes, any size. NEVER generate_video/render_ad for these. Feedback maps to one named move, never a re-render: quieter/louder (music db, audio_gain), faster/slower (speed; slower = zooms and pans at 0.7x), tighten (trim), retime (to a word anchor), recut (order, in-out points), regrade (timeline exposure/contrast/saturation keys).

dryRun.description: true = return the estimated credits this edit reserves and run nothing

word.description: the word or phrase as it is said

at.description: text, instead of start/end: the words appear as this spoken phrase starts (timed from the video's own words; refused if it is never said)

background.description: append_card: hex or a colour name; the user's colour beats the brand palette

bridge.description: join: connects the hook to the first clip

flash.description: true (default) adds a white flash on the cut; false skips it

kind.description: impact (cut before the hook's payoff) or text (words over the cut)

matchCut.description: second in our clip where it starts

shake.description: true (default) adds a camera shake on the cut; false skips it

text.description: text bridge only: words shown over the cut, only when the user asks for them

then.description: text bridge only: a line shown after the text

card_html.description: append_card: your OWN full-frame card as inline-styled HTML ({{logo}} = the brand logo)

clips.description: join: the clips after this video

end.description: seconds into this clip to stop at

match.description: seam match for this clip: auto (default), off, or a grade object

reframe.description: shot change at this seam: auto, off, or a step from 1.1 to 1.5

start.description: seconds into this clip to start from

url.description: clip to join after the video: Library URL, direct file or public post link

db.description: audio_gain -20..+6 dB / music: trim on its automatic level, -20..+12

duck.description: music: 'auto' default = dips while the clip's own sound plays

duration.description: text with at and no until: seconds the words stay, 0.3-30 (default 2)

from.description: music: the second of the track to start from

keepSound.description: voiceover only: true (default) keeps the clip's sound under the voice; false replaces it

layout.description: layout: the frame layout, ONLY when the user or a format asks for one

audio.description: whole-video layout: whose sound (auto = the speaker). A start/end window keeps the video's own sound

background.description: cutout / green_screen: what is behind them: a clip or still URL, a colour, or 'grid' (a cutting mat, the cutout default)

direction.description: split: stack = top and bottom (default on a tall video), side = side by side

kind.description: split (two pictures in one frame), cutout (presenter cut out like a sticker, white outline), green_screen (presenter keyed over a background, no outline), letterbox (a wide band with bars), fisheye (ultra-wide selfie look)

matte.description: how the person is cut: green (filmed on a green screen, keyed free; default) or alpha (a clip with its own transparent background, e.g. from remove_video_background)

outline.description: cutout: the white outline, 0-0.04 of the short side (0 = none)

panels.description: split: exactly two pictures, the first on top (or left): 'this' (the video) or a Library / render URL / direct file

in.description: second of that clip to start from

presenter.description: cutout / green_screen: the person clip, 'this' (default) or a URL

scale.description: cutout / green_screen: the person's height as a share of the frame, 0.2-1

seam.description: split: the line between the panels (default thin white; false = none). Its position comes back so a caption can sit on it

shadow.description: cutout: a soft drop shadow (default true)

src.description: letterbox / fisheye: the picture, 'this' (default) or a URL

x.description: cutout / green_screen: their centre, 0-1 of the width

y.description: cutout / green_screen: where their feet land, 0.3-1.2 of the height; letterbox: where the band sits, 0-1

mood.description: music: mood words for the library pick, or the brief for generated music

op.description: the edit to apply, in order; each op takes only the fields listed for it in the tool description

reframe.description: join: shot change at a same-framing stitch, 'auto' | 'off' | step 1.1-1.5

replace.description: music: true = replaces the clip's own sound

style.description: text: a look name or a textStyle

sub.description: append_card: pill line (default: website) / text: a second, smaller line

tagline.description: append_card: smaller line under the headline

textStyle.description: text op: a textStyle object or preset name, same as style

track.description: music: omit = a library track by mood; a library track name; an audio link; 'generate' (paid, only on the user's ask)

transition.description: join: 'cut' default, 'crossfade', or any ffmpeg xfade name (wipeleft…)

occurrence.description: counted from the at phrase on

word.description: the word or phrase as it is said

until.description: text with at: the words leave as this phrase ends

x.description: text/watermark centre: 0-1 of frame, or px

y.description: vertical centre for text or watermark: 0 to 1 of frame height, or pixels

videoUrl.description: the video to edit: a render / Library URL, a direct file, or a public post link; a URL, not a local file path; use upload_file for local files

title: Post-production edit
